provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: Reconstruct clean L in all four orientations and native thicknesses3..6 within margin2. Compare all consistent defect explanations by completed output; reject ties instead of minimum-defect/scan preference. Removed colour-frequency and local-neighbour fallbacks. Reject conflicting writes to the same destination, retaining equal-colour writes. Sampling/fixtures preserve existing geometry and adjacent defects.
draft_notes.limitations: Native domain: margin2, thickness3..6, two colours, connected output foreground/background, one vertical defect per column and one horizontal defect per row. All candidate outputs must agree; no heuristic fallback. Sampling bounds500 attempts per size and200 sizes. Per-episode exact verification required.
draft_notes.diagnosis:
The failed factory copied the archived solver. That solver finds defects only by local patterns: a notch must have exactly 3 foreground neighbours plus background on both perpendicular sides of its open side, and a bump must have exactly 1 foreground neighbour.

The constructor allows defects in adjacent columns or rows of the same edge, because it only forbids two defects in the same line. Two failures follow from this:

- **Counterexample train pair 2.** The top edge has adjacent notches at (2,4) and (2,5). Each has only 2 foreground neighbours, so neither is detected. As a result, (14,4), (6,5) and (5,5) are never set.
- **Counterexample test pair.** There are adjacent bumps at (1,3) and (1,4). Each has 2 foreground neighbours, so the clears at (11,3) and (11,4) are missed.

The perpendicular-background test causes further misses. It rejects legal notches next to the L's inner corner, and notches diagonally next to a bump. Removing these false negatives by tuning the local tests would just be patching the shown failure.

The actual mechanism is: defects are the symmetric difference between the input and a clean two-bar L, and each line is walked on the clean L. The repair therefore reconstructs that L and applies the generator's fill semantics directly.
draft_notes.constructor_issue: Adjacent defects invalidate archived local neighbour tests. Some inputs also admit multiple clean-L explanations; random sampler rejects distinct-output ambiguity and conflicting destination writes. Original explicit fixture calls are unchanged.
